# Commands

All PHP commands run in Docker through [Task](https://taskfile.dev); `task --list` shows every target. Two testbeds: `app` (framework only) and `app-modules` (CMS + Fluent, `--profile modules`).

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `task up` / `task up-modules` | Start the base / optional-modules testbed |
| `task down` / `task destroy` | Stop both testbeds / also drop their volumes |
| `task build` | Rebuild both images — required after editing anything in `.docker/app/` |
| `task test` | All PHP tests in the base testbed |
| `task test-unit` / `task test-integration` | One suite in the base testbed |
| `task test-modules` | All PHP tests in the optional-modules testbed |
| `task coverage` / `task coverage-check` | Coverage in the optional-modules testbed / fail below 90% |
| `task analyse` / `task analyse-php85` | PHPStan (8.3–8.5 range / target pinned to 8.5) |
| `task rector-dry` / `task rector` | Rector preview / apply |
| `task class-leak` | Unreferenced classes in `src/` |
| `task qa` | All checks and both test runs in parallel |
| `task relock` | Regenerate both harness locks — run after changing `require` in `composer.json` |
| `task verify-lock` | Fail if the committed lock no longer covers the module |
| `task db-build` / `task flush` | Rebuild the database / clear the cache in the base testbed |

- Run single tests with `docker compose -f .docker/compose.yml exec -T app vendor/bin/phpunit --filter <name>`.
- Container paths: the module is `/module`, the harness app `/app`; the module is installed at `/app/vendor/wedevelopnl/silverstripe-fixtures`.

# Project Overview

SilverStripe Fixtures — a test data loader for SilverStripe 6 that writes a whole fixture set in one go instead of record by record through the ORM.

Package: `wedevelopnl/silverstripe-fixtures` (type: `silverstripe-vendormodule`), PHP ^8.3, `silverstripe/framework` ^6.0. Default branch: `6`.

## Layout

```
src/                  # PHP source (PSR-4: WeDevelop\Fixtures\)
tests/Unit/           # Unit tests, no database or framework (WeDevelop\Fixtures\Tests\)
tests/Integration/    # Integration tests, full SilverStripe environment
.docker/              # Test harness: FrankenPHP + MySQL testbeds, the module mounted at /module
.docker/app/          # Harness app: composer files + locks, phpunit/phpstan/rector config (baked into the image)
.apm/instructions/    # Source of CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md — edit here, then run `apm compile`
```

## Rules

- Never edit `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md` or `GEMINI.md` by hand — they are generated by `apm compile` from `.apm/instructions/`.
- Optional integrations (Versioned, Fluent) are `suggest`, never `require`: the base testbed installs the framework alone and must keep passing.
- `silverstripe/assets` is always installed — `silverstripe/framework` requires it.
- Keep every QA gate strict (PHPStan level max, 100% type coverage, 90% line coverage); never loosen one to get a build green.
